correctness.rationale: The exact closed-neighborhood/root-degree identity is proved for each unordered root pair; a maximum-degree-three vertex forces an isolated three-star and otherwise all degree-two vertices must form a clique, leaving exactly four matching-based shapes. Necessity and sufficiency, label multiplicities, all-set EGF and all inclusion-maximal parity counts follow. Independent direct incidence enumeration n=3..7, root-degree branch search n=3..9, and exact factorial symbolic counts n=3..11 agree coefficient by coefficient. Computations validate only finite cases; the component proof covers all n>=3.

value.rationale: This exact infinite-parameter enumeration for a canonical symmetric line-graph family resolves not just L_3 but every three-limited subset and every inclusion-maximal subset. The nonbipartite root triangle creates an essential component omitted by bipartite rook analogues. The resulting facet-size gap between three and ceil(n/2)+1 grows unboundedly and yields a natural nonpurity classification for the hereditary packing complex. This is a meaningful structural/census fact beyond renaming or a scalar bound.
